description: Queue a clip or sequence from the project, or a media file on disk, in Adobe Media Encoder with an encoder preset (.epr) (Export > Send to Media Encoder, or Media Encoder's queue). Whole item, its in to out, or (sequences) the work area; a file can be trimmed with inPoint and outPoint. Optionally starts the queue. Returns once the job is queued; wait_for_event with render_complete waits for it to finish

file.description: Absolute path of a media file to encode without importing it. Give item or file

inPoint.description: With file: start at this time, seconds. Default the start

item.description: The clip or sequence project item to encode. Give item or file

name.description: Item name, when only one item has it

path.description: Bin path, "/"-separated, from the project root

outPoint.description: With file: stop at this time, seconds. Default the end

outputFile.description: Absolute path of the file to write, with its extension

overwrite.description: Replace outputFile if it exists. Default false

preset.description: Absolute path of an encoder preset (.epr)

range.description: With item: the whole item, its in to out, or the work area (sequences only). Default full

removeWhenDone.description: Remove the job from Media Encoder's queue when it finishes. Default false

startQueue.description: Start Media Encoder's queue straight away. Default false

name: encode_media
title: Encode Media
